review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: velt-comment-sidebar-empty-placeholder-v2 REJECTS customer children on the develop SDK even though manifest/velt-primitives.json lists it as accepting. A marker child does not survive; the element renders its own ~14 chars. Treat the manifest as a candidate list and confirm any container against a live probe before composing into it.
learnings.evidence: Live probe on the upgraded element: marker child absent after upgrade. Manifest and phase-1 code both said accepts.

learnings.statement: Velt MOVES customer children into its own tree rather than cloning them, so a primitive given a multi-root fragment throws "removeChild: node is not a child of this node" and can put a dev server into a full-reload loop. Always return exactly ONE stable root element per primitive.
learnings.evidence: A two-root fragment on the thread card reproduced the removeChild throw and the reload loop; collapsing to one root fixed it.

learnings.statement: velt-comment-dialog-toggle-reply calls stopPropagation on its click, so React delegated onClick handlers never fire for anything wrapping it. Use a capture-phase native listener to observe the click without displacing Velt own handler. It also self-renders a live "N reply/replies" label with no host prop, but does NOT render the design avatar group.
learnings.evidence: Delegated onClick never fired; capture-phase listener works and Velt expansion still functions.

learnings.statement: resolveCommentAnnotation and assignUser take a REQUEST OBJECT, not a bare annotation id: {annotationId} and {annotationId, assignedTo: UserContact} per comment-actions.data.model.d.ts. Passing the bare string RESOLVES WITHOUT ERROR AND DOES NOTHING - a silent no-op that reads as "the mutating actions are unverified upstream" when it is really a call-shape bug. Verified: the object form flips status Open->Resolved and populates resolvedByUserId.
learnings.evidence: Bare-string calls returned cleanly with status unchanged across two snapshot runs; object form flipped status and rendered the resolved card immediately.

learnings.statement: DRIVE_VOCAB declares selectUser:["text"] and validateDriveSteps exists to hard-fail a missing companion field BEFORE a browser boots, but a planner-authored {action:selectUser, user:"User 1"} passed every gate and failed at runtime on all 16 blocks ("selectUser undefined did not stick"), costing a full 5-minute snapshot run. The pre-loop validator needs to reject unknown/missing companion keys, not just unknown actions.
learnings.evidence: scaffold-primitives --lint exit 0 and dom-snapshot 0/16 with the same error on every block.

learnings.statement: selectUserRobust matches the host sign-in <select> on option TEXT. Any app whose option labels are descriptive (here "User 1 - member of owner-org-1, viewing owner-org-1") can never be matched by a plain user name, and the failure is reported as a hydration race, which sends debugging the wrong way. Prefer matching by option VALUE, or fall back to it.
learnings.evidence: selectUser "User 1" failed 3 attempts on a page where the select was present and enabled; an idempotent value-based sign-in worked immediately.
